rule_name: Contract to invoice to cash check
finding_summary: Two key contracts were substantially invoiced before corresponding cash receipts arrived.

finding_title: Top five customer concentration is elevated
finding_summary: Top five customers contributed about 76 percent of revenue.
impact_summary: Any delay from the top customer could materially affect repayment.

finding_title: Revenue and bank inflow diverge in Q4
finding_summary: December self-reported revenue exceeded verified bank inflow by more than 20 percent.
impact_summary: Weakens confidence in short-term collection quality.

finding_title: Power usage fell while revenue accelerated
finding_summary: Power consumption trended down for three months while shipped value increased materially.
impact_summary: Requires manual check on outsourced production and revenue recognition timing.
